Sadiq e Aal e Muhammad ka janza hay utha
Sazishi/Lanti Mansoor ne hay zehr Mola ko diya

1
Rotay hain Moosa e Kazim sar ko apnay peet kar
Uth gaya Mola ke ghar se aaj saaya baap ka

2
Khoo hay dhokay se bahaya Mustafa ki aal ka
Kalma go tu ne Nabi ko hay diya kaisa sila

3
Chaak kar ke tum giraiban momino matam karo
Mola Baqir ke pidar ka khoon hay na haq baha

4
Ilm ki khushboo se jis ne dehr ko mehka diya
Ilm e Quran o shairiat sab inhi ki hay ata

5
Mola Jafar ka dain pursa mil ke saray matmi
Aaj phir Syeda ke ghar may hay bicha farsh e aza

6
Jafar e Sadiq ka sadma hay mila sadat ko
Khon hay Jawwad rota ghaib may Mehdi Huda

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/sadq-aal-muhammad-ka-janaza-hai-atha.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip()
head, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n', 2)[1:]
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in head.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
assert roman == old
blocks = body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(blocks) == 7 and len(blocks[0].splitlines()) == 2
for numeral, block in zip('۱۲۳۴۵۶', blocks[1:]):
    lines = block.splitlines()
    assert len(lines) == 3 and lines[0] == numeral
print('Roman wording preserved. Urdu opening and six two-verse stanzas verified.')
PY

Reconstructed the [Urdu lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/57ff01af480e4ef3a974470b7c8cbe65/src/data/lyrics/sadq-aal-muhammad-ka-janaza-hai-atha.md) and preserved the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the opening and all six stanzas align verse for verse. Added the Roman title, set right-to-left direction, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

I read both “Khoo” and “Khon” as خون and preserved the “Sazishi/Lanti” variant as سازشی/لعنتی.
